inputs.text:
Wake up, people. They are playing you right in plain sight. Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala just held a press conference where he called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030, all tied to the narrative around Constitutional Amendment Bill 3. 

Do you really think this is a genuine political clash? It is all part of the grand theater orchestrated by the hidden elites to manage the transition and keep the population distracted while they lock in their 2030 agenda behind closed doors. Sikhala is playing his assigned role in the script, giving the illusion of resistance while the institutions coordinate the whole scheme from the shadows. Don't fall for the official story—it's a managed distraction.
